name: Droste Spiral
desc: An Escher 'Print Gallery' Droste effect: a synthetic banded source wound through a conformal log-polar mapping into an infinite self-similar spiral that zooms and twists inward forever, rendered as hue-cycling spectral bands, nested Escher checker tiles, glowing neon veins, hard black-and-white op-art, or oil-slick iridescence.

twist.doc: spiral pitch — winds the recursion bands into a logarithmic spiral (0 = concentric rings)

zoom.doc: recursion density — how many nested self-similar copies per turn (higher = denser inward zoom)

density.doc: sub-bands / tile count per recursion level

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg)
